dedupe_keys.name: rail infrastructure data for oslo central station

description: Rail Infrastructure Data for Oslo Central Station is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Andreas Nakkerud. This data set contains rail infrastructure data for Oslo Central Station. The infrastructure data was collected from restricted access schematics of the signaling and rail infrastructure in Oslo Central Station and on the connected lines. The data had to be collected by hand since the schematics were only available as images. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
